name: Lady Gaga
hook: A New York pop star named after a Queen song, whose manager turned down a Weird Al parody she had never heard about.
blurb: Lady Gaga, born Stefani Germanotta in Manhattan in 1986, became famous with her first album, 'The Fame' (2008), released by Interscope through Cherrytree and produced with RedOne and Martin Kierszenbaum. Her early producer Rob Fusari has said he came up with 'Lady Gaga' in 2006 from Queen's song 'Radio Ga Ga', through a phone's autocorrect; that is his account. Her music borrowed the dressed-up glam rock of Queen and David Bowie. 'Born This Way' (2011) sold 1.1 million copies in its first week in America. Its title song is about accepting who you are, and through it and her Born This Way Foundation she has campaigned for LGBT rights and young people's mental health. Her later records range from jazz with Tony Bennett ('Cheek to Cheek', 2014) to 'Joanne' (2016) and 'Chromatica' (2020), and her song 'Shallow' won the 2019 Oscar for Best Original Song.
